name: activated_breakthrough
hypothesis:
Development evidence available before this fit: distributed_trapping: MAE 2.52537, worst group 6.36307; finite_capacity_trapping: MAE 5.11432, worst group 10.9732.

Test delayed diffusion-front breakthrough with an inverse-time activation form. Unlike stretched saturation, this suppresses very early response and represents arrival-time dispersion; it must improve forward groups without inventing a measured boundary concentration.
